gaps.explanation: The only revenue schedule (Budgetary Comparison Schedule - Cash Basis - Total Primary Government, trimmed p20 = printed p48) is all funds combined. Its Local Receipts 'Other' 2,674,318 (detail index 10) was recorded entirely as business-type, but it also holds the governmental local receipts the schedule does not print separately: statement (trimmed p9, Total column) Franchise 3,563 + Occupation 4,092 + Carline 427 + Charges for services 7,333 + Lease Fees/Rentals 17,786 + Fees, Permits and Licenses 1,203 + Interest 998 + Donations 9,370 + Insurance proceeds 6,508 + Other revenue 22,011 = 73,291. The governmental schedule lines in detail sum to 373,451 (incl. State Receipts Other 11,378 already split into Homestead 5,248 + Property tax credit 6,130); 446,742 - 373,451 = 73,291 exactly. Fix: remove index 10 and re-add it split by fund type: governmental 'Other' 73,291 (computed: statement governmental receipts not printed on the schedule) and business-type 'Other' 2,674,318 - 73,291 = 2,601,027. Governmental: 373,451 + 73,291 = 446,742 = statement.
